Furthermore, the bull’s attempt to leverage sector tailwinds [E59, E60] is contradicted by the company’s own performance, as it fails to capture this growth, instead delivering a negative ROA [E7] while the sector thrives. The "price-led" signal [E46] confirms that investor expectations are detached from the company's inability to deliver, suggesting that the current valuation is not a bargain but a reflection of terminal operational decline.
